Title: Back in HS I was at ACSL in an elevator with 8 teammates and someone said "everyone jump" and we did...
Author: Jake Koenig
Summary: Back in HS I was at ACSL in an elevator with 8 teammates and someone said "everyone jump" and we did and got stuck in it for an hour. When we got rescued the first thing the fireman said was "Did you guys jump?" and we all vehemently denied it
